prompt: How many AML alerts are open, and how many are at risk of an SLA breach in the next 24 hours?

results.text: 214 AML alerts are open, and 26 are at risk of an SLA breach in the next 24 hours.

sql.command: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_alert_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sla_due_at <= DATE_ADD(logical_time, INTERVAL 24 HOUR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sla_risk_count FROM aml_alert
